svg.title: Card traffic through one machine's payment network
svg.desc: Card traffic through one machine's payment network. PostgreSQL holds the final decision. A scoring proposal that misses its deadline cannot change it. In a 14 s loop, blue dots travel replayer to gateway, through Kafka auth.requests to Flink, and return through Kafka auth.proposals to the gateway and PostgreSQL, where they settle. Continuous fainter aqua dots flow along decisions through Druid to Superset and orange dots along lifecycle through Spark to Hudi on SeaweedFS. Once per loop one scoring proposal is critical red and arrives after its transaction's decision is stored: it stops at the gateway with a late proposal refused label that fades after 2 s.
